thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-84219 fired — synth-check-us-west: probe-fail rate > 30% over 5m. Automatic escalation to oncall. https://pagerduty.example/PD-84219

maria: seeing the page, pinging oncall now. looks like probes started failing ~03:12 UTC.

sam-oncall: acked PD-84219. I'm jumping in. checking synth dashboard…

sam-oncall: dashboard: synth success rate dropped from ~99% to ~58% across us-west/runner-3 cluster. latency for probe requests is 504/timeo ut.

jake: digging into prober logs on runner-3. lots of connection timeouts to external endpoints, `connect: operation timed out` repeated. could be egress or outbound rate limiting.

alice-net: we rolled a firewall tweak at 03:10 (ACL rule 9872) to tighten outbound ranges for a security test. That overlaps the external destinations used by the synthetic suite. I flagged it for rollback but it was gated.

sam-oncall: ok that matches timeline. mitigation options: 1) rollback ACL 9872, 2) restart synth-prober pods to pick up new routing, 3) temporarily route prober traffic through fallback NAT. Which is quickest?

alice-net: rollback ACL is fastest but needs approval from sec. I can push an emergency rollback if oncall requests.

maria: sec is on standby, give me 2m to confirm. in the meantime, try restarting prober to see if backoff/connection retry helps.

sam-oncall: doing quick restart.

sam-oncall: ```bash
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/synth-prober-runner-3
# watching pods: kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=synth-prober -w
```

deploy-bot: restart triggered for deployment/synth-prober-runner-3 by sam-oncall (uid: U-9a3c). Pods recreating.

jake: tailing logs while pods come up: new prober attempts show same timeouts initially, then some success, but still ~20% failures.

maria: sec approved emergency rollback of ACL 9872. alice-net, can you apply now?

alice-net: rolling back now. ```terraform apply -target=module.firewall.rule[9872] -auto-approve``` (will push in ~30s)

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PD-84219 acknowledged by sam-oncall at 2635001240. Escalation paused.

alice-net: rollback complete. Confirming connectivity to external probe targets. Doing quick `curl` from runner-3: 
```
curl -i -sS https://external-probe-target.example/health || echo FAIL
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
...
```

jake: recheck synth metrics: success rate climbing — now 94% and still improving. error rate for tcp timeouts dropping.

sam-oncall: nice. I'll keep monitoring for 10m and then close PD if stable.

maria: customer impact assessment: internal synthetic alerts noisy and PD fired but we have no evidence of actual customer requests failing; external user-facing services show normal traffic. So impact = noisy paging, low customer latency impact. Recommend follow-up: add synth destinations to firewall allowlist, add egress test in CI, and update runbook to include ACL rollbacks.

ops-handoff: noted for post-incident: runbook update ticket in backlog (INC-4502), add canary ip ranges to idps/allowlist, and schedule a postmortem review.

sam-oncall: marking service as recovered in monitoring. PD-84219 will be resolved if stable for 15m. I'll stay on watch. :eyes:

jake: leaving a snippet in runbook draft: "if synth failures coincide with network ACL changes, rollback ACL then restart prober; prefer rollback if customer impact high."

maria: thanks team. small hiccup but good quick rollback.

incident-bot: PD-84219: incident marked 'monitoring' at 2635001310.

sam-oncall: PD-84219 resolved at 2635001338 after 18m of monitoring. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
